messages:
Rina: quick note 77 were seeing a pattern where merged accounts lose their health_score anchor and then get swept by playbook automation (nudges + renewal reminders). caused a bunch of noisy messages to customers yesterday. pausing the renewal_reminder rule for merged accounts for now.
Omar: interesting. do merges clear health_score intentionally? i thought we copy over primary score.
Ben: historically we null-out score during merge to force recalculation. that made sense when model was per-account, but now we merge many accounts into enterprise parents and leave score blank. playbook treats null as low and fires.
Tess: can you share a quick query for scope?
Rina: ran this to check last 14d:
```sql
SELECT count(*) affected, merge_reason
FROM account_changes ac
JOIN accounts a ON ac.new_account_id = a.id
WHERE ac.type = 'merge'
  AND ac.created_at > now() - interval '14 days'
  AND a.health_score IS NULL
GROUP BY merge_reason;
```
Result: 412 merges with null health_score; majority source=import_dedupe.
data-pump-bot: job: backfill-healthscore-2026-03 queued: 412 accounts. ETA 20m.
Omar: proposal: when merging, copy health_score from the dominant account if available; otherwise set a placeholder tag `merged_missing_score` and exclude those from automated nudges until we recalc.
Ben: agree. we should also add a playbook predicate `exclude_if_tagged: merged_missing_score` and an admin dry-run flag.
Tess: for recalc, we can queue recalculation jobs via the scoring pipeline and rate-limit. plan: enqueue score_recalc for merged accounts, run at 1k/hr to avoid spikes.
Rina: immediate actions: 1) suppress renewal_reminder->condition: NOT tag:merged_missing_score (Omar) 2) change merge job to copy score if present else set merged_missing_score tag (Ben) 3) enqueue score_recalc backfill (Tess). owners and ETA: Omar immediate, Ben patch today, Tess backfill tomorrow AM.
Omar: applying suppress now. will monitor dashboards.
Ben: adding unit tests for merge flow and a migration to set tag for historic merges.
Tess: kicking off the backfill as data-pump-bot indicated. will report success/failure.
Rina: thanks team. once patched we'll add a short entry in playbook admin about merged account hygiene and the `merged_missing_score` exclusion.
